content:
This week we’re bringing you the latest updates from Apple’s Certified Refurbished Store. This week’s highlights include the MacBook Neo, newly configured MacBook Air, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

Apple’s Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to shop via Apple’s official website, with savings of up to 15%.

Here’s what you need to know:

  • Outstanding quality, attractive prices
  • Undergoes a strict refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Protected by Apple’s 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased separately
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal from Apple’s Certified Refurbished Store, saving you the hassle of searching yourself. Inventory changes quickly, and the purpose of this article is to let you know which products are currently available, so you can purchase your desired item before it sells out.

Mac

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air prices remain my favourite deals. Both are great for users just entering the Apple ecosystem, or those looking to upgrade to a device equipped with an Apple Silicon chip.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo (256GB storage): $599 (originally $699)
  • MacBook Neo (512GB storage with Touch ID): $679 (originally $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (1TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (2TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,949 (originally $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac (256GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,269 (originally $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,439 (originally $1,699)

Studio Display

As mentioned previously, the Studio Display XDR has appeared in Apple’s Refurbished Store. We always remind everyone that inventory changes quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR (standard glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $2,799 (originally $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR (nano-texture glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $3,059 (originally $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The long-awaited entry-level Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with the higher-end version equipped with an Ethernet port. The entry-level version typically sells out quickly, so if you’re interested, you’ll want to act fast.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, 64GB storage, Wi-Fi): $169 (originally $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet): $209 (originally $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you want the same experience, here are the highlights from Apple’s Refurbished Store this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with blue Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799)

As always, you can head to 9to5Tools to stay on top of all this week’s latest Apple deals.
